entity: Fonds de dotation Sesame (Sesame endowment fund), Grenoble
ownership_stake: not applicable (non-profit endowment fund, no equity ownership)
detail: Founded the Grenoble endowment fund Sesame in 2022 (publicly launched June 2023), a non-profit vehicle connecting local businesses with solidarity associations. As an endowment fund (fonds de dotation) it confers no personal equity stake. Her formal current role within the fund during her ministerial term is not publicly detailed.
